overview_description.description:
Careerist is an ed-fintech platform that trains job seekers for tech careers (in QA, Sales, Support & more), finances them and automates their job hunting. 

Community colleges are declining because people now prefer acquiring specific hard skills rather than general ones, and they seek fast training programs that can be completed in months, rather than years. 

Traditional financial institutions have failed to provide adequate support to underserved communities that have significant potential (approximately 45 million people in the U.S. lack access to or are underserved by traditional credit products). We have developed a unique approach to qualifying these individuals, providing them with more financial protection against potential failures.

Techcrunch: "Edtech meets SaaS in Careerist’s job placement learning platform. The startup trains job seekers through live and self-paced training taught by third-party tutors. The adaptive learning software is meant to help candidates prep for tech interviews. Once a candidate is well equipped, Careerist uses automation to help them apply for jobs."

product.name: Software QA Engineering Training
product.description: A training program teaching software quality assurance fundamentals and manual testing skills to prepare students for entry-level QA jobs.

product.name: QA Automation Training
product.description: A program teaching automation testing skills using Python and test automation tools to prepare students for mid-level QA automation roles.

product.name: QA Bundle
product.description: A comprehensive training bundle combining Software QA Engineering, QA Automation, Python, and SQL courses to build a full QA skill set.

product.name: UX/UI Design Training
product.description: A training program teaching UX/UI design skills including Figma, portfolio building, and internship experience to prepare students for design roles.

product.name: Tech Sales Training
product.description: A program teaching skills for tech sales roles, including product knowledge, sales techniques, and internship simulation to prepare students for sales positions in tech companies.

product.name: Data Analytics Training
product.description: An online bootcamp teaching data analysis skills including SQL, Python, Tableau, and real-world projects to prepare students for data analyst roles.
